text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of posters put up 
here, I can't help but stop and look at 
them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An eye-catching composition and color 
scheme! And yet every bit of necessary 
info is clearly written, even details like 
official social media accounts...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The flow for turning people who showed 
initial interest into actual "customers" 
is so well thought out... I'm really 
learning a lot...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I've got it! This idea might just come in 
handy for my local idol activities!
